notes: Seeded from a research pass on 12 Oct 2026. Every venue's listing URL was tested with scripts/page_text.py that day; 'readable' records the result.

Arts covers theatre, comedy, cinema and screenings, galleries, museum exhibitions and events, talks/readings and dance. Music gigs and club nights belong to nights-music; food and markets to their own scouts.

Galleries print date ranges ('9 October - 12 December 2026'); list each exhibition once, not once per day. Many sites also list art-fair booths or shows at other museums - take only shows at the address below.
Several cinema and theatre pages print dates without a year (e.g. 'Wed 14 Oct'); take the year from the event's own page, never assume it.
Scouts may read this file but must not edit it. Suggested changes go in the run report for a human to apply.
A venue with no_primary_listing: true has no venue or ticket page online; cap its confidence at medium.
Platform 'domains' are enforced by scripts/validate.py and scripts/check_quote.py across all registries: artrabbit.com is now never-use (robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot); timeout.com is discovery-only.
Postcodes left null were not printed on the venue's own site; the venue profiler should confirm them.

zones.core: E2 postcode or within about 1km of Bethnal Green tube. Scanned every run.
zones.fringe: Up to about a 20-minute walk (1.6km) from Bethnal Green tube. Scanned every run.
zones.outer: Further out (Dalston, Hackney Central, Hackney Wick, west Shoreditch, Clapton). Scanned weekly, standout nights only, max 5 candidates per run, flagged worth_the_trip.

platforms.name: Resident Advisor (ra.co)
platforms.why: No public API. Terms 4.4 ban automated extraction without written permission; robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot. Do not fetch, do not use third-party RA scrapers.

platforms.name: DICE
platforms.how: Read public dice.fm venue and event pages one at a time. Mostly music; for arts only use it for performance, spoken-word or comedy events at venues listed below (e.g. Rich Mix).

platforms.name: Ticket Tailor
platforms.how: Read public box-office pages, e.g. tickettailor.com/events/<box-office>. Used by BGWMC for cabaret and comedy nights.

platforms.name: Eventbrite
platforms.how: Location search was shut off in 2020. Only list events by organiser or venue id stored on a venue below. Key in env EVENTBRITE_TOKEN.

platforms.name: DesignMyNight
platforms.how: Leads only (registry-wide policy). Note: it appears to be the actual booking system for Backyard Comedy Club and lists Three Colts Tavern's comedy night, so for those venues it is the best text available. A person should decide whether to allow a per-venue exception; until then, cap confidence at medium.

platforms.name: ma.to
platforms.how: Leads only. Its Backyard Comedy Club page was empty when tested on 12 Oct 2026.

platforms.name: Time Out London
platforms.how: Editorial listings and venue guides; readable with page_text. Use for leads and venue addresses only, then confirm on the venue's own page. Never copy its text.

platforms.name: ArtRabbit
platforms.why: robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot (page_text refused it on 12 Oct 2026). Do not fetch. Gallery shows must come from the gallery's own site.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.how: Not fetched by agents. Events seen there arrive as reader tips or manual entries.
